# Ring of Gullion    Area of Outstanding Natural Beauty

The Ring of Gullion Area of Outstanding Natural Beauty is a unique geological landform, unparalleled elsewhere in Ireland or the UK and was the first ring dyke in the world to be geologically mapped.

[Find out about what we do](https://ringofgullion.org/projects/)

## About our Landscape and Heritage in the Ring of Gullion AONB

Welcome to the Ring of Gullion Area of Outstanding Natural Beauty (AONB), a place where daily life is intertwined with nature, landscape and deep cultural heritage. Situated in south Armagh, the Ring of Gullion is not just a landscape; it is a reflection of the people, stories and traditions that continue to shape this place.

The Ring of Gullion sits at the heart of the **[Mourne Gullion Strangford UNESCO Global Geopark](https://mournegullionstrangfordgeopark.com/about-our-geopark/)**, a UNESCO-designated landscape that connects the Mourne Mountains, the Ring of Gullion and the landscapes of Strangford and Lecale across south-east Northern Ireland.

## Things to do.

The Ring of Gullion offers a variety of Things To Do for visitors to enjoy the countryside. Walkers and cyclists can follow a number of routes ranging in length and difficulty all of which give users the chance to explore the geology, archeology, wildlife and legend of the area.
